title: Matheson History Museum

services.name: Exhibit Halls
services.desc: Chains of Steele: Money, Power, and Influence is the result of a year and a half of research, planning, and writing. Utilizing unique documents stored in the museum’s archive, the exhibit examines two ancestors of Gainesville’s Matheson family, Augustus and Augusta Steele, and the ways that they interacted with and benefited from the institution of American slavery. Augustus was born in 1792 in Massachusetts, and at the time of his birth slavery was outlawed in that state. At the time of his death, he was a devoted Confederate official, advocate for slavery, and enslaver.
